title: FloloreanerPack
description: FloloreanerPack is an ResourcePack by the Official FloloreanerServer Team.
body:
🛠️ FloloreanerPack
This resource pack focuses entirely on a modernized and clean user interface for Minecraft. The Survival Edition replaces the standard status bars with a minimalist design, perfectly tuned for your survival gameplay.
🎨 The New HUD Design
The main feature of this pack is the complete overhaul of the status displays at the bottom of your screen:
•	Custom Health Bar: The classic hearts have been replaced by a stylish, red segmented bar.
•	Modern Hunger Bar: Instead of hunger shanks, you’ll now see a subtle orange bar that takes up less screen space.

🚀 Why choose this HUD?
 Clean Look: Ideal for players who prefer a tidy interface without unnecessary clutter.
 Vanilla-Friendly: Proportions remain familiar, so you'll feel right at home immediately.

⚙️ Compatibility
Details:      Made by the Official FloloreanerServer Team
Type:         UI/HUD Resource Pack
Versions:     Minecraft 1.20+ (Backward compatible to 1.16 possible)
Performance:  Extremely lightweight (no FPS impact)

📥 Installation
1.	Download the FloloreanerPack.zip file.
2.	Move it into your resourcepacks folder.
3.	Activate the pack in-game. Note: If you use other packs, move the FloloreanerPack to the top of the list to ensure the HUD is prioritized!
